# pangolin_private_resource (Resource)

Manages a private resource (the API calls it a site resource): a host, network range, web service, SSH target or gateway that Pangolin clients reach through one or more sites. Changing org_id, mode or nice_id replaces the resource. Import using the format `<org_id>:<private_resource_id>`, e.g. `terraform import pangolin_private_resource.example acme:12`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A database reachable by name through a site.
resource "pangolin_private_resource" "db" {
  org_id         = pangolin_organization.example.org_id
  name           = "postgres"
  mode           = "host"
  site_ids       = [pangolin_site.example.site_id]
  destination    = "10.0.0.20"
  alias          = "db.internal"
  tcp_port_range = "5432"
  role_ids       = [pangolin_role.example.role_id]
}

# A whole network range.
resource "pangolin_private_resource" "lan" {
  org_id      = pangolin_organization.example.org_id
  name        = "office-lan"
  mode        = "cidr"
  site_ids    = [pangolin_site.example.site_id]
  destination = "192.168.10.0/24"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mode` (String) What kind of private resource this is: `host` (a single IP or hostname), `cidr` (a network range), `http` (a web service published on a private domain), `ssh` (an SSH target), or `gateway` (route all traffic through the site).
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `org_id` (String) Organization the resource belongs to.
- `site_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the sites the resource is reachable through. SSH resources in native or push mode accept a single site.

### Optional

- `alias` (String) Fully qualified private DNS name clients can use to reach the resource, e.g. `db.internal`. Wildcards (`*`, `?`) are allowed. Required when destination is a hostname.
- `auth_daemon_mode` (String) Where the SSH auth daemon runs: `site`, `remote` or `native`. Only meaningful for `ssh` mode.
- `auth_daemon_port` (Number) Port of the SSH auth daemon. Only meaningful for `ssh` mode.
- `client_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of machine clients granted access. Replaces the full set on every apply.
- `destination` (String) Where traffic is sent: an IPv4 address or hostname (`host`, `ssh`; hostnames also need `alias`), a CIDR (`cidr`), or the backend host for `http`. Not required for `gateway` or native-auth `ssh`.
- `destination_port` (Number) Backend port. Required for `http` mode, optional for `ssh`.
- `disable_icmp` (Boolean) Block ICMP (ping) to the resource. Defaults to false.
- `domain_id` (String) Domain to publish the resource on. Required for `http` mode.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the resource is active. Defaults to true.
- `nice_id` (String) Human-readable ID, unique per org. Generated when omitted.
- `pam_mode` (String) SSH PAM behavior: `passthrough` or `push`. Only meaningful for `ssh` mode.
- `role_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of roles granted access, in addition to the admin role Pangolin always keeps attached. Replaces the full set on every apply.
- `scheme` (String) Backend scheme for `http` mode: `http` or `https`.
- `ssl` (Boolean) Serve the private domain over TLS. Only used by `http` mode. Defaults to false.
- `subdomain` (String) Subdomain under domain_id for `http` mode.
- `tcp_port_range` (String) TCP ports clients may reach, e.g. `80,443,8000-9000`, or `*` for all (the default).
- `udp_port_range` (String) UDP ports clients may reach, in the same format as tcp_port_range. Defaults to `*`.
- `user_ids` (Set of String) IDs of users granted access. Replaces the full set on every apply.

### Read-Only

- `alias_address` (String) Virtual IP Pangolin assigned to the alias.
- `full_domain` (String) Full private domain of an `http` resource.
- `private_resource_id` (Number) Pangolin-assigned numeric ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pangolin_private_resource.example acme:12
```
